gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-plein: Plein keeps a clear channel leading into each round letter, tidy and dependable. And Impact Label hits harder above it, heavy letters standing apart with a lowercase set noticeably higher.
gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-synonym: Heavy letters standing apart like beads on a rod, each one commanding its own space, define Impact Label. Synonym follows in a plain sans stripe of constant ink, its curves generously open and its lowercase sitting lower.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-almendra: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label stamps each letter down alone, with a high-set lowercase. But if it shrinks too small, that weight fades, while Almendra's deep midsection suits a text serif at body size.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-bree-serif: Impact Label strikes first, heavy and commanding, each letter standing alone. Bree Serif then carries a longer passage with a literary, refined feel, its outsized lowercase giving the reading a generous, unhurried pace.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-quando: Commanding weight comes first from Impact Label, with its high lowercase and open pincer-like c. And Quando lets a longer passage unfold in sparse, widely spaced letters, bookish and traditional, with a tall middle zone in every word.
gen-dafont-impact-label-outfit: Heavy, commanding Impact Label hits first. Outfit then makes a longer read feel approachable, its curves stopping well short of closing, drawn like bent cable with no swelling or thinning.
gen-dafont-impact-label-plus-jakarta-san: Impact Label stands out with beady, separate letters and a high-set lowercase, built for punch. But Plus Jakarta Sans does the quieter work, a precise monoline sans-serif whose curve endings stay well apart.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-amulya: Jelly Crazies wobbles along in blunt round-tip marker strokes, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Amulya reads a longer passage in a modern, contemporary sans, its curves keeping generous gaps.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-chillax: Chillax draws its line like spaghetti laid out in letters, casual and relaxed, with curves left unfinished. Jelly Crazies sits beside it with nearly sealed bowls, so Chillax's open loops feel looser by comparison, a sans playing against a wobbly playmate.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-plein: Jelly Crazies wobbles with playful, nearly sealed bowls and a pace that slows to a leisurely walk. Plein gives a clean channel into each round letter, so shrinking the heading would lose its charm while the sans-serif stays reliable.
